en.headline: Centre tells shops to pull two Marks and Spencer foods
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety says a salad and a pesto may be contaminated with salmonella, and the importer has begun a recall.
body: The Centre for Food Safety on Friday urged people not to eat two imported Marks and Spencer products that may be contaminated with salmonella, and told the trade to stop selling or using the affected batches.

The products are a 285-gram vegan nut and quinoa salad with Middle Eastern tahini, with use-by dates of 8, 9, 10 and 11 October 2026, and a 115-gram pistachio and Parmesan pesto, with use-by dates from 8 to 13 October 2026. Both were imported from Britain by ALF Retail Hong Kong Limited.

The centre said it learnt of the issue through its food-incident surveillance system after the UK Food Standards Agency and the Food Safety Authority of Ireland issued notices that the products might be contaminated and were being recalled. A preliminary check found the importer had brought in and sold the affected items.
The importer has, on the centre's instruction, stopped sale, removed the products from shelves and started a recall, the centre said.

zh.headline: 食安中心籲勿食用兩款馬莎沙律及青醬
zh.dek: 食物安全中心指一款沙律及一款青醬或受沙門氏菌污染，進口商已停售並展開回收。
body: 食物安全中心周五呼籲市民不要食用兩款進口馬莎食品，指產品可能受致病菌沙門氏菌污染，並要求業界如持有受影響批次，應立即停止使用或出售。
涉事產品為285克裝「純素堅果藜麥沙律配中東芝麻醬」，此日期前食用標示為今年10月8日、9日、10日及11日；另一款為115克裝「開心果及帕瑪森芝士青醬」，此日期前食用標示為10月8日至13日。兩款均來自英國，進口商為ALF Retail Hong Kong Limited。
中心表示，透過食物事故監測系統得悉英國食物標準局及愛爾蘭食品安全局發出通告，指有關產品可能受沙門氏菌污染並正進行回收。初步調查發現進口商曾進口及售賣受影響產品。
中心說，進口商已按指示將受影響產品停售及下架，並展開回收。
